import json,re,sys,subprocess
from pathlib import Path
from vgar.evaluation.retrieval.evidence import new_run,write_json,utc_now
files=['PROGRESS.md','docs/BAO_CAO_TASK_CHUA_HOAN_THANH_W3_W6.md','docs/w5_w6_completion.md','docs/m5_m6_retrieval_evaluation.md','docs/superpowers/plans/2026-10-06-fix-vgar-integration-week-1-6.md']
d,m=new_run(Path('artifacts/fixes/w3-w6'),'milestone-8-final-doc-check')
m.update(command_argv=sys.orig_argv)
links=[]
for name in files:
    path=Path(name)
    for target in re.findall(r'\[[^\]]*\]\(([^)]+)\)',path.read_text(encoding='utf-8')):
        target=target.strip().strip('<>')
        if target.startswith(('http:','https:','#','mailto:')):
            continue
        target=target.split('#',1)[0]
        links.append({'document':name,'target':target,'exists':(path.parent/target).exists()})
git=subprocess.run(['git','-c','safe.directory=D:/Project/CAPSTONES/VGAR','diff','--check'],capture_output=True,text=True,encoding='utf-8',errors='replace')
bad=[row for row in links if not row['exists']]
m.update(status='PASS' if not bad and git.returncode==0 else 'FAIL',complete=True,ended_utc=utc_now(),documents=files,links=links,missing_links=bad,diff_check={'exit_code':git.returncode,'stdout':git.stdout,'stderr':git.stderr})
write_json(d/'result.json',m)
print(d)
print(json.dumps({'status':m['status'],'checked_links':len(links),'missing_links':bad,'diff_check_exit':git.returncode},ensure_ascii=False))
raise SystemExit(0 if m['status']=='PASS' else 1)
